meta.title: Courvia — Ball machines for tennis, padel and pickleball
meta.description: Training robots with programmable drills, gear and academy content. Designed in Spain for courts everywhere.

home.heading: Your backhand improves this week
home.lead: Programmable drills, 140 balls per hopper and up to 6 hours per charge. A sparring partner that never tires: you set the shot, the tempo and the spin.
home.pillarTenisBody: Up to 110 km/h with topspin. Calibrated for fast-court bounce.
home.pillarPadelBody: Low trajectories and wall play. The house specialty.
home.pillarPickleballBody: Perforated ball, low net, dinking tempo. A dedicated setup.
home.academyNote: Every robot ships with 12 coach-designed drills. No subscription.
